passive.name: Dragon Soul
passive.description: The Power Gauge cannot be restored. Using The Dragon Concealed from the World or Dragon's Path Across the Heavens activates [Insight]. Using The Enlightened One Takes Dragon Form activates [Unrivaled]. When the Fire Overload state ends, activates [Hidden Until Called Forth] for 5s. Removing [Dragon Soul] removes [Insight] and [Unrivaled]. [Insight] grants Super Armor and activates The Enlightened One Takes Dragon Form at 2 stacks. [Unrivaled] increases Attack by 30%, Defense Penetration by 20%, and grants Super Armor.

advancements: Using Hidden Until Called Forth activates [The Enlightened One Takes Dragon Form]. Using The Heavens Bear Two Dragons activates Deflector of a Thousand Arrows, Awakening of the Hidden Dragon, and The Tiger Commands the Wind 1 time each. When The Heavens Bear Two Dragons hits, activates [Wildfire] on the target. Removing [Dragon Soul] removes [Inferno Sovereign]. Increases damage dealt by 10%.
For every Fire ally in the party, Liu Zhigang's Attack increases by 10%.

Using Fire Dragon Ascension activates [Draconic Armor]. Removing [Dragon Soul] removes [Draconic Armor]. Attacking targets affected by [Wildfire] increases Critical Hit damage by 5% per Wildfire stack. [Draconic Armor]: continuously recovers HP equal to 2% of Attack every 3s, recovers 5% MP every 3s, decreases damage taken by 20%. Duration: 20s.
For every Fire ally in the party, Liu Zhigang's Fire damage increases by 20%.

Enhances [Unrivaled] and [Inferno Sovereign] effects. Attacking targets affected by [Wildfire] increases Fire Overload damage by 5% per Wildfire stack. Using The Heavens Bear Two Dragons activates [Void Mind]. Enhanced [Unrivaled]: increases Attack by 60%, Defense Penetration by 40%, grants Super Armor.
